title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1982-04-06
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 (With Bass EQ) -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell DXLIIS/Dolby B) D

ai_review.summary: Outstanding audience recording of the high‑energy 4/6/82 Spectrum show, with a smoking Shakedown Street and soaring Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers a clear, well‑balanced front‑of‑house (AUD) capture that lets you hear crisp vocals and Phil’s thundering bass despite occasional split‑second glitches. Musically the concert is often cited as one of 1982’s best – tight first‑set grooves and an exceptional second set featuring Shakedown Street, The Other One → Morning Dew, and a powerful encore. Overall the performance feels high‑energy and memorable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars, praising both musical performance and recording quality; only a few low or mixed scores appear, yielding an overall weighted rating around 4.5.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear front‑of‑house capture with crisp vocals and strong bass; a few split‑second cuts/glitches noted, but overall excellent audience sound using Nak 700 mics.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic first set with strong rock‑and‑roll numbers, followed by a second set that builds from Shakedown Street through extended jams and a soaring Morning Dew finale.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for vocal power (especially on Promised Land and Baby Blue) and dynamic interplay with Brent during Shakedown Street; noted as “digging in” on Morning Dew.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass highlighted as thundering and clear, especially on Morning Dew where it “thunders”.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals described as smooth and full‑on (Promised Land, Candyman, LLR); noted for singing the second verse of The Other One.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard work lauded for perfect levels and extended trading licks with Jerry on Shakedown Street.
band_member_comments.Drums: Long drums/space segment (~20 min) received positive remarks; overall solid percussion throughout.
